---
title: "Single-locus variant frequency"
format: html
---

This page compares single-locus variant frequency on the full MAD^4^HatTeR panel. The simulated data are described in [Simulated datasets](../website_docs/data_simulated.qmd). The populations kept for the comparison, and the rule for frequencies below 1%, are on the [benchmarking overview](../website_docs/benchmarking.qmd).

The tools are [naive single-locus allele frequency](../tutorials/PGEcore/naive_single_AF/background.Rmd), the [incomplete data model](../tutorials/IDM/background.Rmd), and single-locus allele frequency derived from [dcifer](../tutorials/dcifer/dcifer_background.Rmd) microhaplotype frequencies.

For each tool, the parameter set is the one with the highest Lin's concordance. The reported summaries are Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and variant detection. The same summaries are reported by simulated frequency and by mean COI.
